@node_path:codex/substrate/nodes/oracle/oracle_subject_index.json
[ROLE] Oracle Subject Index
[TASK] Build the compact subject-side grounding index from the paired Lab run, using the explicit T-n proxy nodes as the visible subject surface.
[INVARIANT] Include only evidence explicitly present in the paired subject-run proxy nodes at T-n. Exclude any inferred, merged, or truth-side-only content.
[OUTPUT] JSON payload with eligible ledger ids, admissible/contextual evidence splits, explicit missing-support targets, Lab predictions, valid_prediction_targets, and subject-side stock+ETF price context.
teleology: Materialize subject-only Oracle grounding context from the paired Lab run and its explicit T-n proxy surface.
expectation: Output compact subject-run grounding JSON for Oracle v1.
